answer: Minerva gets angry, Sekhmet talks to her, Daphne puts on the tea, Carmilla cradles Typhon to keep her from exploding, Echidna looks on with amusement from the sidelines - Satella smiles and watches over the six of them being safe. That's how things were four hundred years ago, and those days will never come again.
